goals.objective: Resume and finish the active Prometheus plan dayline-five-day-density-timer-truth. The product implementation is already frozen; do not change production code unless the single real run exposes a genuine defect. Use the sealed clean G16 candidate to make exactly one actual macOS NativeScheduler live QA attempt, without any Android AVD. Success criteria: (1) the exact app launches and the owner-window evidence visibly proves the expanded five-day Dayline, timer state and category colors plus the planned accessibility/layout bounds; (2) checkpoint, pause/stop, quit/relaunch and offline-cap lifecycle behavior is observed without corrupting data; (3) owned app/Home/temp/build state is cleaned, production digest is unchanged, and no other project or AVD is touched. Stop immediately when those three criteria pass and the existing plan, Boulder ledger, and active goal are reconciled; do not start another recursive verification loop.
